answer: Faiths & Beliefs >> The Holy Quran Question ID: 32918 Country: India Title: Is there any report, which speaks of reading Surah al-Sajdah and Surah al-Mulk between Maghrib and Isha, or about reciting three verses of Surah al-Anaam immediately after Fajr salah? Question: Is there any report, which speaks of reading Surah al-Sajdah and Surah al-Mulk between Maghrib and Isha, or about reciting three verses of Surah al-Anaam immediately after Fajr salah? What about reading or seeing Loh-e-Quran? Answer ID: 32918 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1094/920/B=1432) A person who recites Surah al-Mulk each night shall be safe from the punishment of grave. Some scholars have added Surah Sajdah as well with it. But we could not find the timing between Maghrib and Isha. It is mentioned in Tirmidhi 2/132: قال النبي صلى الله عليه وسلم هي (اي سورة الملك) المانعة هى المنجية تنجيه من عذاب القبر" (الحديث) We could not find any hadith regarding the three verses of Surah al-Ana'm. What do you mean by Lauh-e-Qurani? And what do you want to know about its reading and seeing? First, explain it then you shall be answered. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
